confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors rest on several aggregated sources that broadly agree. Cocktail rests on one thin Expatistan average (7 data points), and the wine glass on a few venue-level listings, so both are weak. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain: sources disagree widely (3-star from about EUR 113 to about USD 239), several are dated 2024-2025, and the July values are my judgement from seasonal patterns. The midrange meal is derived from a per-person good-restaurant average, doubled and adjusted down for mid-range. The FX figure was taken from RBA exchange-rate results returned by search and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors come from Helsinki-specific aggregated price sources, with EUR converted to USD at about 1.14, the rate implied by those sources' own conversions.
